name: session_create_request.v1
description: POST /v1/sessions request body (docs/13 §2.1): the one endpoint where context beats audio — the full ScreenContext IR and the last ~15 timeline events ride in the request body so the agent is context-complete before the peer connection exists. Phase 3 sends screen_context: null and recent_events: [] — context capture lands in Phase 4. The server validates the snapshot and events against protocol/ schemas and rejects the whole body with 400 VALIDATION_SCHEMA, never a partial ingest (docs/13 §2.1). additionalProperties is false in the house input-schema style (protocol/tools/*.json): new request fields are a server-contract change (docs/13 §9), never a client improvisation.

user_id.description: Must equal the JWT sub claim — the server verifies and rejects a mismatch rather than honoring it; sub is the only principal in the system (docs/13 §1.2).

screen_context.description: Full screen_context/v1 IR — the last operational screen, support surfaces excluded (docs/07 §2.1) — or null when the client has no capture. Phase 3 always sends null; capture is Phase 4. Shape authority is docs/07 and protocol/schemas/screen_context.v1.json when it lands; only the version marker is pinned here. An unknown version is rejected with 400 VALIDATION_UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (docs/13 §1.1).

recent_events.description: The last ~15 app_event/v1 timeline entries, oldest first; may be empty (Phase 3 always sends []). Event shape authority is docs/07/08 and protocol/schemas/app_event.v1.json when it lands; only the fields every event variant carries are pinned here.
